newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Korean Airlines to introduce 10 cent surcharge.
newsitem.headline: Korean Airlines to introduce 10 cent surcharge.

text.p: Korean Airlines has become the latest carrier to announce a fuel surcharge ex-Amsterdam.
The Seoul-based carrier will introduce a fuel surcharge of ten U.S. cents per kilo from November 15, said Korean Air's Dutch cargo sales manager, Mike Zimmerman.
Zimmerman said Korean, like some other carriers, has decided to introduce the fuel surcharge after an IATA meeting, which is to be held in Geneva on November 13.
Last Thursday KAL announced an ex-Germany surcharge of 15 pfennig a kilo effective November 1. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542-7706 Fax+44 171 542-5017
